watermark.notes: Use ?orderby=15&pagesize=48&pagenumber=N. orderby=15 = Created on DESC. Walk page 1 (newest) backward until watermark productId is hit, then index forward. NopCommerce product IDs are monotonically increasing (auto-increment) - verified: orderby=15 page 1 = 97413,97410,97408..., page 2 starts 96939,96937,96936... (strictly descending). Counter-control: orderby=5 (Name A-Z) returned different ordering (96884,95122) confirming orderby=15 is honored.

auditNotes.wafBypass: Browser User-Agent header is sufficient; no Playwright required at crawl runtime. Cloudflare rule-selective for XSS/SQLi/bot-UA/no-UA but browser-UA + plain GETs pass with cf-cache-status: DYNAMIC.
auditNotes.categoryParentChildOverlap: Parent /firearms walk (828) includes children /rifles, /shotguns, /non-restricted-center-fire (page-1 100% overlap with parent). Walking the parent suffices for the firearms-tree. Sub-categories NOT included in catalogUrls to avoid double-walk overhead - parent /firearms covers them.
stageNotes: Stage 1: apex reliablegun.com 301-redirects to www.reliablegun.com; canonical = https://www.reliablegun.com.

Stage 2: heavy-8-batch probe - Cloudflare active rule-selective (XSS/SQLi/no-UA/bot-UA blocked); browser-UA crawl path clean. cf-cache-status: DYNAMIC on category pages. No CAPTCHA on homepage or category pages. No age gate.

Stage 3: <meta name="generator" content="nopCommerce" /> + Nop.customer cookie + SevenSpikes plugins + Nop-Templates Motion theme. .aspx errorpage confirms IIS/ASP.NET origin under Cloudflare. adapterType=generic-retail per SKILL Stage 3 mapping (NopCommerce falls under generic-retail).

Stage 4: Nav crawl of top-menu top-level (with-subcategories) parents + leaf links. 17 firearm-relevant cats kept; 6 non-firearm cats (clothing, books, camping, cookware, coolers, first-aid) excluded per Rule C. /firearms parent walked 18 pages x pagesize=48 = 828 unique productIds. /used and /firearms mostly disjoint (2/48 page-1 overlap). /sales overlay adds ~30 unique. data-productid is canonical NopCommerce numeric ID - perfect for dedup.

Stage 4g extraction sample: 3 cards from /firearms?orderby=15&pagesize=48 page 1 - title (from .product-title a), url (from same anchor), price (from .price.actual-price), stockStatus (from .grid-stock-dot/.grid-stock-qty). Product 1 (new firearm): all 4 fields populate. Products 2-3 (used + consignment): title+url populate, price hidden on grid (priceVisible:false) - typical NopCommerce consignment pattern.

Stage 5: perPage probed - <select id="products-pagesize"> options 6/12/24/48; ?pagesize=96 rejected (server fell back to default 12, last-page=69 confirmed). Max verified = 48. Pagination: ?pagenumber=N (NOT ?page=N - NopCommerce default). page-1 doesn't carry param; page 2 zero-overlap with page 1 (different productIds).

Stage 6: <select id="products-orderby"> options: 0=Position(default), 5=Name A-Z, 6=Name Z-A, 10=Price L-H, 11=Price H-L, 15=Created on. 3-outcome counter-control with cache-bust: default first 3 productIds {96884,95122,...}; orderby=15 first 3 {97413,97410,97408}; orderby=5 (counter) first 3 {96884,95122,...} == default. Verdict: orderby=15 differs from default = HONORED. Monotonic descent confirmed page 1 (97413,97410,...) -> page 2 (96939,96937,...) on NopCommerce auto-increment productIds. sortParam=?orderby=15, sortVerified=true.

Stage 7: navigate-from-watermark - sort honored (orderby=15) + monotonic auto-increment productId provides ID-jump verification source. No public WP-REST-equivalent date filter for NopCommerce; full-catalog-sweep not needed.

Stage 8: /sitemap.xml flat single-file with 6441 <loc> entries. NopCommerce flat URL namespace: categories and products both use single-segment slugs. Estimated ~150 entries are categories/pages; true product count ~6291. productCountMethod = {method:'sitemap', url:'/sitemap.xml'} - accept ~2% category overcount documented in fieldConfidence.
Stage 9: candidate JSON assembled. extractionTested=true with sample of 3 (1 fully populated, 2 consignment with hidden price). All 9 required validator fields present.
